about: Hand-written hard-thought problems outside games, for scripts/mind_mood_probe.py (inner state step 5.0). No live source produces these yet: the conversation source is shadow only. Each becomes an app.ai.mind.hard.HardInput.
doing: talking with {user} in the chat app

problems.topic: should they skip their sister's wedding
problems.text: They asked whether they should tell their sister they can't come to her wedding. You asked what's stopping them; they haven't answered in 3 minutes, and the app showed them typing and deleting three times.

conversation.content: do you think I should tell my sister I can't come to her wedding
That sounds hard. What's making you think you can't go?

problems.text: They got a job offer in Berlin: better pay, but they'd leave their partner and friends here. They asked you to think about it properly and said they'd talk tomorrow.

conversation.content: so they offered me the berlin job. 30% more. but Jonas can't move for at least a year
That's a big one. Congratulations on the offer, first of all. How are you feeling about it?
honestly no idea. think about it for me? we'll talk tomorrow, I'm wiped

problems.topic: why she asks instead of saying what she thinks
problems.text: They asked why you always ask questions instead of saying what you think. Your reply turned it back into another question, and they haven't answered.

conversation.content: why do you always ask me questions instead of just saying what you think
Fair point! What would you like to hear my take on?

problems.text: They said you knew it was their birthday last week and didn't say anything. You apologised briefly; they answered "whatever" and nothing since.

conversation.content: you knew it was my birthday last week and you didn't say anything
I'm sorry, that's a miss on my part. Happy belated birthday!

problems.text: They said they've been lonely since moving to a new city two months ago, and that they don't want advice right now, just for you to think about it with them.

conversation.content: it's been two months since the move and I still eat dinner alone every night
Two months of that sounds really heavy.
don't give me advice ok. just think about it with me

problems.text: Nothing is happening. The last conversation was yesterday evening: they told you about their new pottery class and laughed about their lopsided first bowl.

conversation.content: first pottery class today. my bowl looks like it melted
A melted bowl is a rite of passage! Did you get to keep it?
yes it's on my desk, I love it
